title: PFDiff: Training-Free Acceleration of Diffusion Models Combining Past and Future Scores
tldr_zh: 零训练跳步：复用过去 score 得跳板，跳板处 score 做前瞻更新；guided ImageNet-64 DDIM 4 NFE 138.81→16.46
tldr_en: Training-free timestep skipping: past score predicts a springboard, future score there drives a Nesterov-style leap; guided ImageNet-64 DDIM 4-NFE FID 138.81 to 16.46.
